annotations.title: Find the capo position for a key

description: Works out where to put a capo. Give the key you want to sound in (for example to match a singer or a recording) and, optionally, the open-chord key you want to play shapes in. Returns the capo fret, or the easy options if no shape key is given.

shape_key.description: Optional. The key whose open chord shapes you want to play, e.g. "G" or "Em".

sounding_key.description: The key the music should sound in, e.g. "Bb", "F# minor".

name: find_capo
title: Find the capo position for a key
